sentences.text:
The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 287 of 2024,
under Sections 498A, 493, 323, 504, 506, 313 I.P.C. and 67a Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station Gadwar, District Ballia.
2. At the outset Sri Achyut Jee, learned counsel for the applicant, prays for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to file afresh at an appropriate stage.
3. Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

4. Let the certified copy of the documents, if any, be returned to the learned counsel for the applicant as per the Rules of the Court.
5.
Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned A.G.A. for the State, is present.
